semantics.definition: The list beside a page: what you choose from, such as the tree of merons, the batches in Review or Governance's pages. A real nav with its name; its rows are tree rows, so the keyboard reaches every one. It draws the list only: the app places it, beside the page with Panes where two panes fit, in a Drawer where one fills the window. The usual name for this in design systems.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one sidebar every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Hold the list you choose from beside a page: what sits on top, then the rows, in one list or in named groups.

list.groups: the rows in named groups, each under its name
